plugins.name: number-headings
plugins.description: Normalize and number Markdown headings. Fixes heading level structure and adds hierarchical numbering (Chinese numerals for H1, Arabic dot-notation for H2+).

plugins.name: ppt-editor
plugins.description: Generate PPT slide content following the AnHeng (安恒信息) corporate template design specification, producing cover, TOC, chapter, content, and contact slides.

plugins.name: ppt-planner
plugins.description: Analyze a Markdown document and design the page-by-page content plan for a slide deck — chapter division, per-page content, and layout — outputting a reviewable .ppt-design.md draft for ppt-editor to consume.
